explanation: A₁(N) is the number of maximal Sidon subsets of [1,N] (IsMaximalSidonSetIn: Sidon, and no further element of [1,N] can be added), as on erdosproblems.com/862. The page derives A₁(N) ≥ 2^{(0.16+o(1))N^{1/2}}. The statement is: for each ε > 0, eventually 2^{(0.16−ε)√N} ≤ A₁(N). Faithful.
